notes.title: Release Incoming!
notes.notes:
🚀 Unreal Kingdoms is Entering Beta! 🎮

We’re thrilled to announce that Unreal Kingdoms is preparing for Live Beta Testing on Steam, Xbox, and PlayStation! 🧪🔥

The journey has been wild—and thanks to our amazing community and supporters, we’re now getting ready to open the gates to our multi-platform beta experience.

👾 Explore. Conquer. Trade. Dominate.
Whether you’re a space explorer, a battle-hardened warrior, or a crafting tycoon—your kingdom awaits.

✅ Cross-platform support
✅ Player-owned economy
✅ Next-gen visuals & combat
✅ Beta Access Coming SOON

Make sure you're signed up, geared up, and ready to make your mark in Unreal Kingdoms.

📅 Beta Access Date: TBA (Very Soon!)
💻 Steam | 🎮 Xbox | 🕹 PlayStation
